basic_details.short_information: The Government of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions (Department of Personnel and Training) (DoPT) has notified vacancies for the Information Commissioner post. Applications must be sent by post or through email to Under Secretary (IR II), Hall No. 31049, Department of Personnel and Training, Kartavya Bhavan-3, New Delhi on or before 20 November 2026, under advertisement number 4 January 2026-IR II. Candidates must be persons of eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social service, management, journalism, mass-media

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Government of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions (Department of Personnel and Training) (DoPT) for filling prestigious positions in the Central Information Commission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notified post is Information Commissioner under the Central Information Commission, responsible for handling appeals and complaints under the Right to Information Act, 2005.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Information Commissioner position as per the official recruitment notification released by the Department of Personnel and Training.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form either by post or through email is 20 November 2026. Applicants must ensure timely submission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The applications for the Information Commissioner post must be submitted in offline mode by sending particulars in the enclosed proforma by post or through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the eligibility qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be persons of eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social service, management, journalism, mass-media, or administration and governance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years. Persons who have attained the age of 65 years are not eligible for appointment to the Information Commissioner post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: The salary and allowances are payable as per the Right to Information (Term of Office, Salaries, Allowances and Other Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2019.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to the Under Secretary (IR II), Hall No. 31049, Department of Personnel and Training, Kartavya Bhavan-3, New Delhi-110001 or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Information Commissioner position released by the Department of Personnel and Training.
